{{Quote|OK, sir. Are you aware that the reproduction of such plans is prohibited?|City Planning Department Receptionist to [[Carl Johnson]].}}
The '''City Planning Department Receptionist''' is a minor character in {{SA}}.

==History==
===Background===
She works as a receptionist at [[Las Venturas City Planning Department]].

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
She is doing her normal duty when [[Carl Johnson]] comes to the City Planning Department to take pictures of [[Caligula's Palace]] blueprints during [[Architectural Espionage]]. She asks him if she can help him, and Carl replies that he would like to see the architectural plans for Caligula's Casino. She accepts his request and asks him if he is aware that the reproduction of such plans is prohibited. Then Carl tells her that he is only after some reference, after which she says that the plans are located on the top floor. Then she returns to attend her duties.

Later in the mission, Carl causes a distraction by causing a fire to break out in the building and the alarm ringing. She quickly leaves the building along with several other staff members.

Alternatively, she can be quickly killed after CJ gains access to the top floor by the means of a stealth kill. This does not have any impact on the mission or storyline whatsoever.

==Character==
===Appearance===
She does not have her own character model; she uses a rich lady [[Pedestrians|pedestrian]] model instead. She has straight, shoulder length black hair and wears a black dress and black heels. She also wears a golden necklace and golden matching bracelets on both hands. Moreover, she wears light pink lipstick.
